requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_category IN {'A','B'} AND construction_date >= '2017-01-01' AND tank_type IN {oil_residue_tank, oily_bilge_water_holding_tank} AND individual_tank_capacity_m3 > 30, THEN tank_outer_shell_separation_m >= 0.76.
requirement.requiredInputs: Ship category/date and tank inventory/capacity/separation measurements
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: For category A and B ships constructed on or after 1 January 2017 all oil residue (sludge) tanks and oily bilge water holding tanks shall be separated from the outer shell by a distance of not less than 0.76 m. This provision does not apply to small tanks with a maximum individual capacity not greater than 30 m^3.
